mission_10: Masterful! You have completed the Explainable AI chapter by implementing model distillation for interpretability. Your implementation transfers knowledge from a complex neural network teacher into an interpretable decision tree student using temperature-scaled soft targets combined with hard labels. The temperature parameter reveals the teacher's confidence structure, enabling the student to learn nuanced decision boundaries that simple label fitting would miss. With fidelity evaluation, rule extraction with confidence scores, and progressive distillation for depth-accuracy optimization, you now possess a complete toolkit for making black-box models transparent. This is the culmination of XAI: from local explanations (LIME, SHAP) to global understanding (PDPs, rules) to model simplification (distillation).
